comments: Chosen assumptions: ego approaches a slower car in its own lane at 10-11 m/s, with agent1 17-19 m ahead at 7-8 m/s. At 2 s ego initiates a late left lateral evasion, exposing the source-lane leader to a close rear-quarter interaction during departure. Agent1 holds lane and target speed. The target lane is initially empty. Ego is the initiating car and agent1 the responding car. Seven-second horizon; no collision is required.
